title: Is [18F]-DPA-714 PET a Good Marker of Neuroinflammation in Autoimmune Encephalitis?
official: Is [18F]-DPA-714 PET a Good Marker of Neuroinflammation in Autoimmune Encephalitis?
summary: This study aims to evaluate the effectiveness of \[18F\]-DPA-714 PET imaging in detecting neuroimmune activity in patients with autoimmune encephalitis (AE). The primary objective is to compare \[18F\]-DPA-714 binding in AE patients to healthy controls.
